findings.spec_constraint: ISO 8601 UTC date-time, format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ (trade updates)
findings.evidence_quote: Data Type & Format: Trade updates: ISO 8601 UTC date-time, format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
findings.reasoning: HKMA explicitly provides the field 'Event timestamp' to capture the exact date and time when a reported lifecycle event occurred. For trade lifecycle events/updates, the specification requires the ISO 8601 UTC date-time format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. The requirement is therefore fully met without conflict.
